description: Shows the raw bytes of up to four vMIDI streams as they arrive

params.text: Switches its input into the display; the lamp beside it is lit while that input is being shown

inputs.text: One of the four vMIDI streams that can be shown on the display

notes: the display holds the last seven messages; each line reads a running count, then the input number, then the message bytes in hexadecimal, with dashes for bytes a short message does not have
all four inputs come up switched on when the module is added, and a stream stops appearing the moment its button is switched off
the buttons latch, so one press switches an input off and the next switches it back on
